errors.description: The drawing frames the lower shirt front and shows the bottom of the hidden placket lifted open at the hem to expose the bar-tack that secures it, annotated 'Hidden Placket Bar-tack'. The photograph is cropped at chest-to-upper-abdomen level, so neither the hem nor that bar-tack appears. The locked prompt asked for a vertical macro down the placket and did not list the bar-tack among the required features, and the option's own description defines it purely as the covered fly front, so this is logged rather than treated as a construction failure.
errors.expected: drawing additionally shows the placket bottom opened at the hem with a bar-tack
errors.actual: chest-level macro of the closed fly; hem and bar-tack outside the frame

lockedFeatures: true covered fly front - one clean cloth band from collar to bottom of frame with zero visible buttons or buttonholes
both long edges of the fly are crisp folded edges with no topstitching, which is what a hidden placket requires
unbroken smooth expanse of cloth either side of the fly
front view, white cotton poplin, plain grey studio background, no red notation, annotation text or Chinese label carried over from the drawing
placket band width proportionate to the shirt front, consistent with the drawn band
notes: Verified at 3x magnification of the placket column: no buttons, no buttonholes, no topstitch rows anywhere on the fly - the defining absence for this option, and the thing a generic 'plain placket' substitution would have got wrong. The drawing's red vertical lines and its 'Hidden Placket Bar-tack' caption were correctly read as notation and did not bleed into the render. Approved on attempt 1.
